accounts_synced_provider_ck.name: accounts_synced_provider_ck
accounts_synced_provider_ck.value: "accounts"."origin" = 'manual' or ("accounts"."provider" is not null and "accounts"."provider_account_id" is not null)

budget_limits_scope_ck.name: budget_limits_scope_ck
budget_limits_scope_ck.value: "budget_limits"."category_id" is not null or "budget_limits"."account_id" is not null

pocket_movements_sign_ck.value: case "pocket_movements"."kind" when 'accrual' then "pocket_movements"."amount_cents" > 0 when 'deposit' then "pocket_movements"."amount_cents" > 0 when 'withdrawal' then "pocket_movements"."amount_cents" < 0 else "pocket_movements"."amount_cents" <> 0 end

generated.as: case when parent_id is null then null else true end
